summary: Completed frontend testing for Settings page conversion from modal to full landscape page. All 9 test cases passed successfully.

issues: Console warnings about HTML hydration errors - <th> cannot be child of <span>, <tr> cannot be child of <span>. These are React hydration warnings but don't affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Dashboard.jsx has some HTML structure issues causing React hydration warnings (span elements wrapping table elements). This is a cosmetic issue and doesn't affect functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings page has been converted from modal to full landscape page at /settings route. All 4 tabs (Appearance, Dashboard, Security, Help) are working. Widget visibility toggle in Dashboard tab correctly hides/shows widgets on the main Dashboard page. localStorage key 'dashboardWidgets' stores the widget configuration.

settings_page_route.description: Settings page loads at /settings route in full landscape mode (not a modal dialog)

settings_4_tabs.description: Settings page has 4 tabs: Appearance, Dashboard, Security, Help

appearance_tab_content.description: Appearance tab shows Color Theme grid (12 themes) and Font Size selector (Small/Medium/Large)

dashboard_tab_content.description: Dashboard tab shows drag-and-drop widget list with 5 widgets, show/hide toggles, and Save/Reset buttons

security_tab_content.description: Security tab has Change Password form with Current Password, New Password, and Confirm New Password fields

help_tab_content.description: Help tab has Interactive Tutorial and Video Tutorial sections with Start Tutorial and Watch/Download buttons

profile_dropdown_navigation.description: Profile dropdown 'Settings' click navigates to /settings page (not opens a modal)

widget_visibility_toggle.description: Dashboard widgets visibility respects the saved configuration from Settings - toggling Statistics Cards off hides it on dashboard, Reset restores it

back_arrow_navigation.description: Back arrow on Settings page navigates back to dashboard properly

buyer_role_access.description: Settings page works correctly for Buyer role with all 4 tabs and 5 widget toggles
